Built for how you actually work Built for how you actually work PROFILES Create clean lines between work, freelance, and personal life, with separate tabs, logins, and AI. Context switch between them in just a swipe. LIVE WORK Dia pulls together the places where work is actually happening (like GitHub and Notion) in your tab bar. Click once and land directly in the right PR, spec, or draft. BETTER MEETINGS Every call starts with the right meeting page, agenda, notes, and related docs open, with a gentle countdown so you’re on time. All you have to do is show up. SPLITS See a meeting on one side and a doc on the other without juggling windows. Dia remembers your layout, so your favorite setup for recurring 1:1s or focus time is one click away. DECKS Ask Dia for a deck and your scattered context becomes real slides — headers, layout, and flow you can present without a redesign. ORGANIZED TABS Keep your workspace tidy by grouping related tabs with appropriate naming, so you see “Design Review” or “Q2 Planning” instead of a long strip of unnamed pages. dia_forwork.title: Dia Browser | Work
dia_forwork.bodyText: What's New Apps Security Send download link Watch the trailer video Dia is built for work We’re getting Dia ready for companies of all sizes. What is Dia? Dia is a modern, AI-native browser that helps teams work faster, built with strong security controls and enterprise-grade management in mind. What makes Dia better than using my old browser with ChatGPT? Dia brings secure, native AI workflows into your browsing and apps, so you get productivity and compliance in one place. With Dia, there is no context switching, fewer copy-and-paste loops, and strong admin controls for data, access, and updates. Is Dia SOC 2 compliant? Yes. The Browser Company completed a SOC 2 Type II examination for Dia covering security, confidentiality, and privacy for calendar year 2025. The final report was issued in 2026. To learn more about our compliance program and to request a copy, visit trust.diabrowser.com. Does Dia or its AI systems train on corporate data? Dia has zero data retention (ZDR) agreements with all partners. Users can opt out from sharing content to improve Dia (see our Privacy page), and enterprises can disable content sharing org-wide. Does Dia offer AI security controls? Yes. Dia supports MDM controls that let you disable all AI-powered features on specific websites. How is my data kept private in Dia? Your data stays on your device and is stored encrypted. When you make an AI-powered request, we send only what’s needed to fulfill it (e.g., your prompt and relevant page context) through our servers to our AI partners. Does Dia support MDM controls? Yes. Dia supports standard Chromium enterprise policies, including Google Chrome Cloud Management, and also provides Dia-specific MDM policies such as AI controls and managed updates. Dia makes it easy for your IT team to be managed and deployed. Does Dia support Single Sign On (SSO)? Yes. Dia supports SAML-based SSO with most identity providers, including Google, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and more. You can also use Dia’s MDM policies to restrict sign-ins to approved email domains, ensuring only your employees can access Dia securely. Can I import my bookmarks, extensions, profiles, tabs, passwords, and history? Dia supports standard import flows from all major browsers.
